lenses.label: STEREO COR1-B · μ=10
lenses.title: COR1-B electron-density tomography CR2053 · μ=10
lenses.description: STEREO-B/SECCHI COR1 polarized-brightness observations reconstructed into electron number density for Carrington Rotation 2053 P1 with the archive μ=10 regularization. SciPy resamples the spherical grid to Cartesian display voxels. A separately recorded radial weight softens display emission at 1.5–1.7 and 2.5–4.0 solar radii; the float density cube is unchanged.
lenses.summary: STEREO-B reconstruction from 4–18 February 2007, using the archive μ=10 regularization and a display-only radial taper.
